_comment: Peak system memory (GB) per (framework, concurrency), used by plot_pareto.py when a framework lacks a *_metalstat.jsonl sidecar. Values for the 8 Qwen3-0.6B frameworks below were recovered by extracting label positions from the previously-committed pareto_Qwen3-0.6B_{chat,agent}.pdf (commit 01f4ea3, 2026-04-25), because the original sidecars were wiped on 2026-04-27 when sglang was added via run_all.sh without --skip-existing. They are reconstructions to within ~0.3 GB of the original metalstat peaks. To replace with fresh metalstat data, re-run the missing frameworks with --skip-existing and remove the corresponding entry here.
